summary: Required runtime beneath @assistant-ui/react; you get it automatically. Same pipeline and provenance, only three runtime dependencies, but it ships source and source maps, which makes the installed package 9.9 MB unpacked.
reasoning: It is a transitive dependency of @assistant-ui/react, so adopting react means adopting core.
Three runtime dependencies: nanoid, assistant-cloud and assistant-stream.
Published through the same OIDC trusted pipeline with SLSA provenance on 67 of 70 versions, including 0.3.31.
Tree-shaken code is what reaches the browser; the large unpacked size is mostly src and .map files.
caveats: Do not add it as a direct dependency unless you are using it outside React. Import from @assistant-ui/react instead.
Declares @assistant-ui/store and @assistant-ui/tap as required peers, so both must be allowlisted with it.
